hook: Your microfibre cloths stopped working. Here's why.

steps.say: Wash them on their own, at forty to sixty degrees.
Use just a little liquid detergent.
Skip the fabric softener and dryer sheets.
Air dry, or tumble on low.

safety.say: And no bleach, it breaks down the fibres.

result.say: They grab dust like new again.
result.headline: Grippy again
